ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 25% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips and along the lateral margins; central regions show contiguous dark pixels intersected by high-contrast linear white streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel amplitudes ranging from 10 to 40 pixels; prominence increases toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral edges leading to sharply pointed, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel structures (barnacle colonization) localized heavily on the terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, unaligned high-intensity linear pixel paths (scratches) distributed across the dark-pigmented central areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological growth (barnacle infestation) creating a fringe-like distortion of the natural trailing edge boundary on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of stalked barnacles protruding several pixels beyond the primary trailing edge boundary at the lobe extremities.
